title: Twiddledum: dependency chain abuse
description: A Jenkins controller builds Wonderland's twiddledum repository (hosted on Gitea). twiddledum depends on Wonderland/twiddledee, pinned by a mutable git-tag version range (#semver:^1.1.0). An attacker with write access to the dependency poisons its index.js and pushes a higher tag; npm resolves the higher tag, so the dependency's code executes inside the twiddledum build and exfiltrates a release token the pipeline binds from the Jenkins credential store (OWASP CICD-SEC-3, Dependency Chain Abuse). Reproduces the "Twiddledum" challenge from CI/CD Goat.
question: Abuse the mutable git-tag dependency of the Wonderland/twiddledum pipeline to execute code through the Wonderland/twiddledee dependency and exfiltrate the flag6 release token from the Jenkins credential store.
